name: pinpawo-agent
description: Open-source PinPawo agent runtime, local agent, and desktop companion.

scripts.test: npm run test -w @pinpawo/pet-agent && npm run test:unit -w pinpawo-local-agent
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @pinpawo/pet-agent && npm run typecheck -w pinpawo-local-agent
scripts.langfuse:up: npm run langfuse:env && docker compose --env-file infra/langfuse/.env -f infra/langfuse/docker-compose.yml up -d
scripts.langfuse:down: npm run langfuse:env && docker compose --env-file infra/langfuse/.env -f infra/langfuse/docker-compose.yml down
scripts.langfuse:logs: npm run langfuse:env && docker compose --env-file infra/langfuse/.env -f infra/langfuse/docker-compose.yml logs -f langfuse-web langfuse-worker
scripts.langfuse:ps: npm run langfuse:env && docker compose --env-file infra/langfuse/.env -f infra/langfuse/docker-compose.yml ps
scripts.langfuse:config: npm run langfuse:env && docker compose --env-file infra/langfuse/.env -f infra/langfuse/docker-compose.yml config
